_comment: One recording: where it is, which channels, which parameters, where results go. Copy to config.json and edit -- config.json is gitignored, because it points at one machine's data.
_annotations_comment: Optional. A reference scoring to compare against; delete this section if you do not have one. nyx produces a hypnogram either way.
_window_comment: Analysis window in seconds. Delete to score the whole recording. Run nyx.check_signals(recording) first to see where usable signal starts and ends.
